group.label: Delivery Queue & Logging
group.comment: Events are queued in the database and delivered by the cron group "montu_affiliate" (Magento cron must be running). Settings marked "global" apply to the whole installation.

field.label: Delivery Schedule (global)
field.comment: Cron expression that runs the delivery job. Default: */5 * * * * (every 5 minutes).

field.label: Batch Size (global)
field.comment: Maximum events delivered per cron run (default: 50).

field.label: Max Attempts
field.comment: Delivery attempts per event before it is marked max_retries (default: 5). Applies to events queued from now on; failed events can be requeued from Marketing > Montu Affiliate > Event Log.

field.label: Request Timeout (seconds)
field.comment: Maximum time in seconds to wait for Montu's response (default: 30).

field.label: Delivered Events Retention (days, global)
field.comment: Delivered events older than this are deleted by the delivery job. 0 keeps them forever (default: 30). Failed events are never deleted.

field.label: Log Level (global)
field.comment: Minimum level written to var/log/montu_affiliate.log (default: Warning). Use Debug only while investigating a problem.
